COMPUTER STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Computer storage, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Computer set up, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer set up.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer set up.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer set up.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer set up.

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool

5. When learning Operating System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Operating System.

6. When learning Evolution and Development of Computers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution and Development of Computers.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Evolution and Development of Computers.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

8. When learning Data communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Data communication.

9. When learning Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.

10. When learning Central Processing Unit, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Central Processing Unit.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Central Processing Unit.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Central Processing Unit.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Central Processing Unit.

11. When learning Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.

12. When learning Data Transmission Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Transmission Media.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Transmission Media.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Data Transmission Media.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Transmission Media.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Program Development Overview and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

3. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer set up.

4. A — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

5. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System.

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution and Development of Computers.

7. A — CPU
